# Behror Solar

> BehrorSolar.in is Global Green Energy's local solar platform for Behror, Neemrana and surrounding areas. Behror Solar was founded and is led by Mahendra Yadav, a partner and investor in Global Green Energy. Global Green Energy is an Authorised Tata Power Solaroof Channel Partner installing rooftop solar across Behror, Neemrana and northeast Rajasthan — residential, rural and industrial. We handle PM Surya Ghar subsidy paperwork and JVVNL net metering end to end, and build with Tata Power Solaroof components and Hot-Dip Galvanized structures engineered for a 30-year service life.

Based near Hanuman Mandir, Mohalla Nainsukh, Behror, Rajasthan 301701. Service area: Behror, Neemrana (urban, rural and NIA industrial), Bhiwadi, Kotputli, Shahjahanpur and the wider Alwar region. Contact: +91 94144 53454 / myadav@behrorsolar.in.

## Main pages

- [Solar Installation in Behror & Neemrana (Home)](https://behrorsolar.in/): Rooftop solar across Behror and Neemrana — urban and rural — by Global Green Energy, an Authorised Tata Power Solaroof Channel Partner. Residential, commercial and industrial, with PM Surya Ghar and net metering support.
- [Solar Installation in Neemrana](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-installation-neemrana): Solar in Neemrana — urban, rural and NIA industrial — from a Tata partner based 20 minutes away in Behror. PM Surya Ghar subsidy and JVVNL net metering handled end to end.

## Residential system sizes

- [3 kW Solar System](https://behrorsolar.in/3kw-solar-system): 3 kW rooftop solar for a typical home (~250 sq ft roof, ~500 units/month). Tata and custom TOPCon options, pricing, subsidy math and payback.
- [5 kW Solar System](https://behrorsolar.in/5kw-solar-system): 5 kW rooftop solar for larger homes (~400 sq ft roof, ~700 units/month). Two offerings, subsidy math, savings and real installs.
- [10 kW Solar System](https://behrorsolar.in/10kw-solar-system): 10 kW rooftop solar for high-consumption homes. For eligible residential systems above 3 kW, central CFA remains capped at ₹78,000. The 10 kW threshold relates to the simplified technical-feasibility/load-enhancement process, not a maximum subsidy-eligible system size. Pricing, subsidy, savings and payback.

## Systems and products

- [Solar Panels — DCR & Non-DCR](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-panels-behror-neemrana): Solar panels for Behror and Neemrana — DCR vs non-DCR, Tata and premium TOPCon modules, and how panel choice affects subsidy and generation.
- [Solar Battery & Backup](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-battery): Solar battery and backup options — when a battery makes sense, sizing, and how hybrid systems keep power during cuts.
- [Hybrid Solar](https://behrorsolar.in/hybrid-solar-behror-neemrana): Hybrid solar with battery backup for Behror and Neemrana — grid-tied solar plus backup for power cuts.
- [On-Grid vs Hybrid vs Off-Grid](https://behrorsolar.in/on-grid-hybrid-off-grid-solar-behror-neemrana): A plain-language comparison of on-grid, hybrid and off-grid solar with local context to help choose the right system.

## Subsidy and guides

- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy](https://behrorsolar.in/pm-surya-ghar): PM Surya Ghar in Behror & Neemrana: up to ₹78,000 central CFA plus ₹17,000 Rajasthan support for eligible consumers, JVVNL net metering, documents and application help. The additional ₹17,000 Rajasthan–RRECL state subsidy applies only to eligible consumers enrolled in the 100/150-units-free Mukhya Mantri Nishulk Bijli Yojana.
- [TOPCon vs Mono PERC Field Test](https://behrorsolar.in/topcon-vs-mono-perc-field-test): A real side-by-side field test measuring TOPCon vs Mono PERC generation on matched rooftop arrays in northeast Rajasthan.
- [Solar Guides](https://behrorsolar.in/solar-guides): Solar guides and explainers covering subsidy, net metering, system types and panel technology.
